name: Product tour / changelog
summary: Real footage of an app, recorded with Playwright and played in a framed window. Callout cards and highlight rings land on narration cues. Work that can't be filmed yet is shown as a flow diagram.
goodFor: a demo of a web app
length: 45–90 s, one scene, one section per change
steps: Find the changes (git log --stat, uncommitted diff) and pick 3–5 a viewer would notice

Pick a look before drawing anything (docs/looks.md): 3–4 looks made up for this product's film, each framing its UI, never restyling it (a 1–3 word name + a ≤12-word line each), 1–2 palettes besides theirs, a backdrop that fits (anim sheet <video> --scene <id> --backdrops); write style.md and theme.json
Run the app locally; edit record.mts (one record() per shot: page, scrolls and clicks, with mark() at each moment)
npx tsx <video>/record.mts http://localhost:<port>; check stills of the clips (ffmpeg -ss <t>) before building on them
Write narration.txt (one sentence per change, a {cue:} where each shows up); anim voice
scene.json: the shared footage window (type video, src clips/<shot>.webm); per section, play the clip segment between marks, timed to the cues

Per beat, one region: focus the camera on it (1.6–2.4×), hold 1.4–2.2 s, a spotlight on it and a chip naming it (≤ 6 words, beside it, never over it); highlight rings over the footage (rects placed `in` the window, measured from stills) where a chip isn't enough
score.json (beat-fitted tempo, foley: true), anim score <video> --levels
anim lint (including the walkthrough rules: focus-zoom, focus-hold, camera-speed, chip-words, chip-time, chip-over), anim sheet --times …, anim render, anim eval voice

scaffold.narration: Here's what's new. {cue:change1}First change, in one sentence. {cue:change2}Second change, in one sentence. {cue:change3}And what's coming next.

sections.brief: Title and the list of changes as chips.
Change 1: footage of it, a highlight ring and a callout card.
Change 2: footage, a ring and a callout.
What's next, as a flow diagram.
